notes: No sitemap.xml or robots.txt is served; product list was built from the Life, Health, Personal accident, Critical illness, Retirement income, Wealth accumulation and Prestige series menu pages and every product link on them.

Annuity category follows Great Eastern's own menu: plans listed under Retirement Income (GREAT Lifetime Payout 3, GREAT Prime Rewards 3, GREAT Retire Income, Lifetime Boost) are tagged annuity even where the legal type is participating whole life or endowment. Plans under Wealth Accumulation are tagged by legal type (endowment, ilp, whole_life).

GREAT TotalCare 2 (ip_rider) has no page of its own; it is documented on the GREAT SupremeHealth page and in the shared benefit schedule PDF. The GREAT SupremeHealth life-stage landing pages (new to work, parents with young children) are variants of the same product and are not listed separately.
Prestige Global Health Options is an international medical plan (insured by Great Eastern, administered by Cigna), not an Integrated Shield Plan; tagged hospitalisation as the nearest category.

Restricted eligibility: GoGreat Term Life is for Dependants' Protection Scheme policyholders only; Great Eastern Cares Term Plan is only for clients of a Special Needs Trust Company; GREAT Flexi Saver is invitation-only; GREAT SP Special is an exclusive maturity offer for qualifying customers.

Same plan served at two URLs: Lifetime Boost (retirement-income and wealth-accumulation) and GREAT Prime Rewards 3 (same two paths); GREAT Life Multiplier is also served at life-insurance/great-flexi-protect-series.html. Each is listed once.
Not listed: GreatLink fund pages and ILP Fund Centre (funds, not plans), calculators, Great Legacy Programme (estate-planning information page), and travel, car, home and maid products.

Some page text contains replacement characters in place of dashes and apostrophes; evidence quotes were chosen to avoid them. Brochures rarely state entry ages, so entry-age facts appear only where a page or PDF states them.
Product pages answered scripted requests with HTTP 200; no page was bot-blocked.
